data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek word 'melodia', meaning 'song' or 'melody'. Melodie is a name rich in musical symbolism, reflecting the harmonious and rhythmic nature of life. This name was traditionally given to girls who were believed to have a melodic voice or who were musically inclined. The name Melodie carries the meaning “Song or Melody” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Melodie usually hope their child will grow to embody song or melody and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name evokes the image of a soul in perfect unity with the divine, producing beautiful music that praises and glorifies God.
